query: Tengo 12 hallazgos de una revisión. Quiero que un agente adversarial verifique cada uno y luego consolidar solo los confirmados. ¿Lo hago con llamadas Agent en paralelo o con un workflow?
expected_behavior: Explains that a per-item verification stage feeding a consolidation is the Workflow shape (pipeline/parallel with typed schema results), but that the Workflow tool runs only on the user's explicit opt-in (ultracode / 'use a workflow')
Without that opt-in: 12 Agent calls in one message (fan-out), collect and filter in the main session
Notes the caps (16 concurrent, ~15 agents guideline) and that every lobo still pays its startup
notes: Guards both directions: not reaching for the Workflow tool without opt-in, and knowing it exists when the graph has stages.
